_comment: Single source of truth for XERA supply/allocation numbers. Every deploy script, backend config, and doc should READ this file rather than hardcoding these numbers a second time. Changing a number here without updating the corresponding deployed contracts does NOT change the deployed contracts — this file documents intent/config inputs, it does not retroactively alter immutable on-chain constants.

mining._comment: GLOBAL across BNB + TON combined, NOT per chain. Enforced atomically in Postgres (xera_mining_allocation_state / xera_reserve_onchain_claim) — this is the actual source of truth for the cap. Each chain's smart-contract maxAllocation is a secondary, INDEPENDENT safety ceiling only (currently set to this same 75,000,000 figure on each chain as a generous ceiling — the two chains' contract caps do NOT sum to the global cap, and must never be read as if they did).
